raw_html: [[Legendary Virulent Poison Guard|Legendary Virulent Poison Guard]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Legendary Virulent Poison Guard]]:''' This item carries a potent venom that is delivered when enemies strike you. When an enemy strikes you, the poison has a chance to be applied, dealing 5d6 Constitution damage if your enemy fails a DC100 [[Fortitude]] saving throw.
